title: 2266. Count Number of Texts

examples.explanation: The possible text messages Alice could have sent are: "aaadd", "abdd", "badd", "cdd", "aaae", "abe", "bae", and "ce". Since there are 8 possible messages, we return 8.
There are 2082876103 possible text messages Alice could have sent. Since we need to return the answer modulo 109 + 7, we return 2082876103 % (109 + 7) = 82876089.
